title: Furnishing Alcohol to Minors
key_points: Purposely or knowingly offering, serving or making alcohol available to a person under 21 (exceptions for religious observance and parents in a private home).
elements: The suspect purposely or knowingly offered, served or made available an alcoholic beverage
To a person under the legal drinking age (21)
No exception applies (religious observance, or parent or guardian in a private home)
